cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

lig=Chem.MolFromMolFile('lig.mol',removeHs=False)
sub=Chem.MolFromMolFile('sub.mol',removeHs=False)
x=lig.GetConformer().GetPositions()
pcs=[]
for i in [8,25]:
 nb=[a.GetIdx() for a in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors()]
 v=sum((x[i]-x[j])/np.linalg.norm(x[i]-x[j]) for j in nb)
 v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
 pcs.append(x[i]+2.32*v)
pd=np.mean(pcs,axis=0)
x-=pd
for i,p in enumerate(x): lig.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
pr=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(lig)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(lig,pr)
ep=ff.AddExtraPoint(0,0,0,fixed=True)-1
for i in [8,25]:
 ff.MMFFAddDistanceConstraint(i,ep,False,2.32,2.32,300)
 for a in lig.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
  ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(a.GetIdx(),i,ep,False,111,117,5)
ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(8,ep,25,False,110,114,5)
ff.Initialize()
for k in range(5):
 r=ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
 if r==0: break
x=lig.GetConformer().GetPositions()
# right-handed basis giving phosphines negative y and Pd at origin
u=x[25]-x[8];u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
v=-(x[8]+x[25])/2;v-=np.dot(v,u)*u;v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
w=np.cross(u,v)
x=x@np.array([u,v,w]).T
for i,p in enumerate(x):lig.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
print('ligand minimization:',r,'E',ff.CalcEnergy(),'Pd-P positions',x[[8,25]])
Chem.MolToMolFile(lig,'chelate.mol')
# Put B(8)-C(9) alkene along x with Pd at anti face (B C A clockwise in picture).
sx=sub.GetConformer().GetPositions()
mid=(sx[8]+sx[9])/2
u=sx[8]-sx[9];u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
# n points on the Pd-bound face of the drawn cycloheptadiene
n=np.cross(sx[9]-sx[8],sx[7]-sx[8]);n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
v=-n
w=np.cross(u,v)
sx=(sx-mid)@np.array([u,v,w]).T+np.array([0,2.02,0])
for i,p in enumerate(sx):sub.GetConformer().SetAtomPosition(i,p)
print('substrate positions',sx[[0,7,8,9,10,13]])
combo=Chem.CombineMols(lig,sub)
N=combo.GetNumAtoms()
# MMFF only for organics; add Pd as an explicit restraint point.
pr=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(combo)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(combo,pr,ignoreInterfragInteractions=False)
ep=ff.AddExtraPoint(0,0,0,fixed=True)-1
for i in [8,25]:
 ff.MMFFAddDistanceConstraint(i,ep,False,2.32,2.32,300)
 for a in combo.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetNeighbors():
  ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(a.GetIdx(),i,ep,False,110,118,3)
ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(8,ep,25,False,108,116,3)
b,c=lig.GetNumAtoms()+8,lig.GetNumAtoms()+9
for i in [b,c]:
 ff.MMFFAddDistanceConstraint(i,ep,False,2.16,2.16,300)
 # C=C/Pd at ~70 degrees
# preserve alkene coordination orientation through its ligand substituents,
# approximately normal to olefin plane.
for i,j,k in [(b,c,lig.GetNumAtoms()+10),(c,b,lig.GetNumAtoms()+7)]:
 ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(ep,j,k,False,94,110,3)
# Two alternative in-plane olefin orientations. Current C=C parallel P-P.
# Loose Pd coordination square plane planarity via P-Pd-C angles.
ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(8,ep,b,False,135,170,1)
ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(25,ep,c,False,135,170,1)
ff.Initialize()
for k in range(8):
 r=ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
 if r==0:break
print('full preopt',r,ff.CalcEnergy())
coords=combo.GetConformer().GetPositions()
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{N+1}\nPd(Xantphos)(eta2-anilinocycloheptadiene); explicit H\n')
 for a,p in zip(combo.GetAtoms(),coords):
  f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p[0]: .9f} {p[1]: .9f} {p[2]: .9f}\n')
 f.write('Pd 0.0 0.0 0.0\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(combo,'organic.mol')
print('atoms',N+1,'P indices (1-based)',9,26,'alkene C',b+1,c+1,'Pd',N+1)
PY

from rdkit import Chem
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
fn='opt_syn/xtbopt.xyz'
if not Path(fn).exists():
 lines=Path('opt_syn/xtbopt.log').read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[0]); lines=lines[-(n+2):]
 Path('progress.xyz').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n');fn='progress.xyz'
lines=Path(fn).read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[0]); sym=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:2+n]];x=np.array([[float(t) for t in l.split()[1:]] for l in lines[2:2+n]])
print('FILE',fn,'Formula',dict(Counter(sym)))
for i,j in [(8,103),(25,103),(82,103),(83,103),(82,83),(84,85),(74,103),(22,103)]:
 print('distance',i+1,j+1,round(np.linalg.norm(x[i]-x[j]),4))
A,B,C,D,E,F,G=range(81,88);N=74;Pd=103
na=np.cross(x[B]-x[A],x[G]-x[A]);na/=np.linalg.norm(na)

print('N/Pd side markers',np.dot(na,x[N]-x[A]),np.dot(nb,x[Pd]-(x[B]+x[C])/2), 'normal agreement',np.dot(na,nb))
m=Chem.MolFromMolFile('organic.mol',removeHs=False)

for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,x[i])
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(m)

# Check organic bonding lengths.
err=[]
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx();d=np.linalg.norm(x[i]-x[j])
 if sym[i]=='H' or sym[j]=='H':
  if not .88<d<1.3:err.append((i,j,d))
 else:
  if not 1.15<d<2.05:err.append((i,j,d))
print('Abnormal organic bond distances',err)
# Shortest nonbonded contacts, excluding 1-3 pairs.
dm=Chem.GetDistanceMatrix(m)

for i in range(n-1):
 for j in range(i+1,n-1):
  if dm[i,j]>2 and np.linalg.norm(x[i]-x[j])<1.65:contacts.append((i+1,j+1,np.linalg.norm(x[i]-x[j])))
